meta.name: tdd
meta.description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用测试先行的方式驱动功能开发与缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望在写代码前先通过测试明确预期行为
copy.tagline_en: Write tests first to drive feature development and bug fixes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you like to define expected behavior with tests before writing code

howto.what: Claude 会按 TDD 循环工作:先写失败测试,再写刚好让它通过的代码;只在与你确认过的公共接口(seam)上写测试,避开实现耦合等反模式;探索代码库时会读取 CONTEXT.md 对齐术语。
howto.when: 当你想用测试先行方式开发功能或修 bug、提到 "red-green-refactor",或要求集成测试时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 TDD 实现用户注册,先写失败测试。
say.note: Claude 会先确认测试缝,再写红测试。

say.text: 修这个登录 bug,先写一个失败的测试复现它。
为这个模块写集成测试,遵循 red-green-refactor。

howto.what_en: Claude follows the red-green TDD loop: writes a failing test, then the minimum code to pass. Tests are written only at seams you confirm, avoiding anti-patterns like implementation coupling. It reads CONTEXT.md to align terminology.
howto.when_en: When you want to build features or fix bugs test-first, mention 'red-green-refactor', or ask for integration tests.

say_en.text: Use TDD to implement user registration; write the failing test first.
say_en.note: Claude confirms seams before writing the red test.

say_en.text: Fix this login bug by first writing a failing test that reproduces it.
Write integration tests for this module following red-green-refactor.
